lunar_days.title: 1st lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: Energy is at zero as the body reboots.
health_and_body.recommended: Meditation, quiet walks in the fresh air, planning your schedule for the month, light plant-based food.
health_and_body.caution: Any physical overexertion, alcohol, hot baths. The head and face are especially vulnerable today.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A haircut is strictly contraindicated. It is believed to “cut off” the plans set in motion for the month and to shorten life. A fine time for a gentle peel and moisturizing masks.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: Do not start anything new. This day is purely for analysis, planning and building strategy. Signing contracts and important meetings are best postponed.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams reveal your true desires for the month ahead. They rarely come true literally, but they set the right emotional direction.

lunar_days.title: 2nd lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: Active accumulation of energy, increased appetite.
health_and_body.resonance: Physical nourishment and the start of training.
health_and_body.recommended: Starting new exercise cycles, drawing up a diet, going to the gym.
health_and_body.caution: Greed and anger lead to energy depletion. The teeth and mouth are vulnerable.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A favorable day for a haircut: hair will grow faster and its structure will improve. A good time for nourishing and vitamin wraps.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: An excellent moment to look for sources of funding, to be generous, and to begin carrying out the plans you thought through on the 1st lunar day.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams serve as a direct pointer to karmic tasks. If you dreamed of an obstacle, it means you are heading the wrong way in real life.

lunar_days.title: 3rd lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: A sharp surge of energy, a tendency toward aggression.
health_and_body.resonance: Intensive work with the muscular frame.
health_and_body.recommended: Maximum physical exertion, martial arts, a visit to the sauna or bathhouse to release tension.
health_and_body.caution: Passivity is absolutely contraindicated, as stagnant energy provokes illness. The back of the head and the ears are vulnerable.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: Steer clear of salons. A haircut may bring unexpected expenses and worsen your well-being.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: A period of active, forceful action. An excellent time for competition, defending your interests and pushing stalled projects through.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams test your readiness for the fight. If you retreated or lost in the dream, you urgently need to train your willpower in real life.

lunar_days.title: 4th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: The focus shifts to the inner world, the voice and the breath.
health_and_body.resonance: Working with the vocal cords and the cervical spine.
health_and_body.recommended: Singing, breathing practices, walks in nature, working with sound.
health_and_body.caution: A higher risk of a flare-up of cervical osteochondrosis. Do not strain the vocal cords or let the throat get chilled.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A neutral time for a haircut, though it may provoke a slight melancholy. The day is ideal for aromatherapy and neck care.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: Work with information, databases, archives and the family business will go well. Avoid hasty decisions: this is a day of choosing between good and evil.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams may expose hidden dangers or show the true face of the people around you.

lunar_days.title: 5th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: Peak absorption of nutrients and transformation of energy.
health_and_body.resonance: Active work of the digestive tract.
health_and_body.recommended: Full, hearty meals. Today food burns without residue and turns into pure energy.
health_and_body.caution: Fasting is strictly forbidden. The stomach and esophagus are vulnerable. Avoid heavy synthetic food.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A haircut today attracts financial prosperity. The skin responds well to rejuvenating treatments and injections.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: A day of transformation. Do not be afraid to change your plans radically if your intuition points to a new path. A good time to stand up for your principles.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams are often about roads, journeys or labyrinths. It is a good sign if you weep in your dream, as it symbolizes cleansing.

lunar_days.title: 6th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: Harmonization of the inner currents, serenity.
health_and_body.resonance: The respiratory system, bronchi, upper respiratory tract.
health_and_body.recommended: Pranayama (breathing practices), aromatherapy, massage, quiet rest and sound therapy.
health_and_body.caution: Cold drinks and standing in drafts. The bronchi are vulnerable, so the risk of colds is high.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A haircut is not recommended, as it may attract a cold or weaken the sense of smell. An excellent day for rejuvenating treatments.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: A passive, contemplative day. Routine tasks, scientific work, searching for information and working with documents go well.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams are often prophetic but call for subtle intuitive interpretation. Treat the symbols in a dream as metaphors.

lunar_days.title: 7th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: Activation of the speech centers, a powerful energy of words.
health_and_body.recommended: Reciting mantras, singing, healing through words and affirmations.
health_and_body.caution: Lying, foul language, tooth extraction. Everything said aloud today comes true quickly.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A haircut today will sharpen intuition and sensuality. A favorable time for coloring the hair.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: The ideal time for advertising campaigns, public speaking, negotiations and job interviews. The power of persuasion is at its peak.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: They may carry useful information. Take words heard in a dream literally, since the answer to your questions lies in them.

lunar_days.title: 8th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: Inner alchemy, energetic restructuring at the cellular level.
health_and_body.resonance: The stomach, the peripheral nervous system.
health_and_body.recommended: Cleansing the digestive tract, preparing medicinal remedies, gentle fasting.
health_and_body.caution: Overeating, aggression, working with open flame, drinking alcohol.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A haircut will attract longevity and health. The day is ideal for complex cosmetic procedures.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: A successful start for any new venture, as well as moves and business trips. A day for transforming your business and finding new partners.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams point to your unresolved karmic tasks and your true purpose in life.

lunar_days.title: 9th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: An energy slump, susceptibility to illusions, anxiety.
health_and_body.recommended: Clearing your space, forgiving grievances, strength training to release accumulated negativity.
health_and_body.caution: Getting drawn into conflicts, eating mushrooms, gazing into the mirror for long.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A haircut is strictly contraindicated, as it can attract illness. It is better to postpone a visit to the cosmetologist.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: There is a danger of deception, fraud and collapsed deals. Stick strictly to safe, everyday routine.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Nightmares tonight are normal. They show your suppressed fears, which you need to let go of.

lunar_days.title: 10th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: The opening of the energy channels, a powerful connection with the ancestral line.
health_and_body.resonance: The rib cage, the bones, the prostate.
health_and_body.recommended: Family feasts, a visit to the bathhouse, laying the foundation for new undertakings and for building a home.
health_and_body.caution: Loneliness, quarrels with relatives, breaking family bonds.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A haircut today is categorically not recommended. Only light nourishing masks are favorable.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: An excellent day for teamwork, growing a family business, investments and closing major deals.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: You often dream of ancestors and relatives. Powerful guidance and protection from your lineage may come through dreams.

lunar_days.title: 11th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: A tremendous surge of uncontrolled energy (Kundalini energy).
health_and_body.recommended: Finishing what you have started, careful stretching workouts, solitude.
health_and_body.caution: Passivity is dangerous, but overexertion is harmful too. Avoid using sharp and cutting objects and undergoing surgery.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A haircut will heighten your senses and insight. A good day for caring for the ends of the hair.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: Every action must be brought to its logical end. Abandoning things halfway is not allowed today.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams tonight carry little significance, so there is no need to look for deep meaning in them.

lunar_days.title: 12th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: The opening of the heart chakra, serenity, emotional receptivity.
health_and_body.recommended: Showing mercy, charity, giving gifts, water treatments.
health_and_body.caution: Strain on the heart, quarrels, complaining about fate (you may get stuck in that state for a long time).

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A haircut is not recommended, as it raises the risk of injury and of attracting misfortune.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: A good day to ask for sponsorship, make peace agreements and seek compromises with competitors.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams usually come true and bring bright, prophetic images.

lunar_days.title: 13th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: Rejuvenation of the body, renewal of energy, cyclicality.
health_and_body.recommended: Treatment, massage, a visit to the dentist, study, correcting the mistakes of the past.
health_and_body.caution: Dwelling on old grievances and refusing to take in new information.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: An ideal day for a haircut: hair will grow thicker and fresh energy will come into your life. The best time for cosmetology.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: Teamwork, information exchange and brainstorming go well. It is favorable to return to old projects.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams show the way to solve old problems. Long-ago dreams often recur tonight.

lunar_days.title: 14th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: Maximum physical and mental activity ahead of the Full Moon.
health_and_body.recommended: Beginning the most important and large-scale projects, dry fasting, cleansing the body.
health_and_body.caution: Sadness, laziness, apathy, excessive fluid intake, straining the eyes.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A haircut may weigh on your peace of mind, so it is better to cancel the visit to the hairdresser.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: One of the best days of the month for launching a business, investing and taking decisive steps. Taking a risk is justified today.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams carry no important information and are often heavy because of the approaching Full Moon.

lunar_days.title: 15th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: Peak sensitivity of the nervous system. A day of temptations and overload.
health_and_body.recommended: Cultivating peacefulness and patience, strict self-control. A light, gentle diet, herbal infusions.
health_and_body.caution: The pancreas is vulnerable, and overeating leads to gastritis. Any surgical intervention is contraindicated.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: Refrain from haircuts and aggressive cosmetic procedures on the day of the Full Moon peak.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: Do not start new things and avoid big shopping. Finish current tasks and pay back debts.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams reflect inner struggle, hidden passions and the dark side of the subconscious, which calls for awareness.

lunar_days.title: 16th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: A harmonious distribution of strength, a release from the tension of the Full Moon.
health_and_body.recommended: Moderate physical exercise, walks in the fresh air, drinking clean water and herbal blends.
health_and_body.caution: Overeating, animal food and alcohol. The blood-forming organs are especially vulnerable.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A wonderful day for a haircut: hair will be manageable and the style will hold for a long time. Any skin-cleansing treatments are favorable.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: A day of creativity, calm completion of tasks and harmony within the team. Tension eases, so you can plan trips and sign documents.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams are often prophetic and bring long-awaited psychological relief or the answer to a question that has been troubling you.

lunar_days.title: 17th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: The opening of inner freedom, the joy of life and the energy of love.
health_and_body.recommended: Celebrations, time with friends, dancing, light outdoor exercise.
health_and_body.caution: Alcohol, aggression, suppressing emotions, chilling the lower back.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A haircut today will lift your mood, draw admiring glances and bring a surge of feminine or masculine energy.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: One of the most auspicious days for closing deals, presentations, creative projects, weddings and large gatherings.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams show the state of your inner freedom. If you dreamed of a celebration or of flying, you are on the right path.

lunar_days.title: 18th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: A mirror day: the world around you reflects your hidden problems and complexes.
health_and_body.recommended: Cleansing the skin, the bathhouse, massage, giving up bad habits and other people’s advice.
health_and_body.caution: Yielding to other people’s influence, overtiring yourself, oversleeping. The kidneys and skin are vulnerable.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: Cutting the hair is categorically not recommended. It may worsen your health and provoke a rash or hair loss.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: Intrigue, deception and provocation from those around you are possible. Do not get drawn into arguments, and check all incoming information.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams may reveal how the people around you truly feel about you, or point to the root of your psychological blocks.

lunar_days.title: 19th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: Heavy energy, an increased risk of injuries and emotional breakdowns.
health_and_body.recommended: Cleansing with fire (sitting by candlelight), mental cleansing, solitude.
health_and_body.caution: Alcohol, new acquaintances, noisy company, loans and financial borrowing.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: Refrain from any manipulation of your hair and appearance, as the risk of an unsuccessful result is great.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: A critical day. Postpone signing contracts and important negotiations. Do only routine work that calls for working alone.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: You may have heavy, frightening dreams caused by the general energetic background of the day. Do not take them to heart.

lunar_days.title: 20th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: Overcoming doubts, spiritual uplift, victory over fears.
health_and_body.resonance: The upper back, the shoulders, the circulatory system.
health_and_body.recommended: Yoga, stretching, breaking bad habits, fasting or a light plant-based diet.
health_and_body.caution: Pride, arrogance, abrupt movements, straining the shoulder girdle.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A favorable day for a change of image and a haircut: hair will grow quickly and your mood will improve.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: An excellent time for a breakthrough in your affairs, a change of job, solving difficult problems and overcoming long-standing barriers in business.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams are often lucid. In a dream you can receive a hint about how to resolve a long-standing life problem.

lunar_days.title: 21st lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: Activity, a striving for justice, cleansing of the blood and liver.
health_and_body.resonance: The circulatory system, the liver, the bone marrow.
health_and_body.recommended: Hardening, outdoor sports, water treatments, drinking pomegranate juice and clean water.
health_and_body.caution: Overtiring the legs, joint injuries, heavy and fatty food.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A wonderful day for a haircut: hair will grow stronger and your appearance more polished and radiant.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: A day of teamwork, creative uplift and finding like-minded people. Any group projects and trips are successful.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams often reflect the state of your health and your energetic potential.

lunar_days.title: 22nd lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: Accumulation of wisdom, receiving secret knowledge, a slowing of processes.
health_and_body.resonance: The lower spine, the sacrum, the hips.
health_and_body.recommended: Learning something new, working with archives, a moderate joint warm-up, spiritual practices.
health_and_body.caution: Surgical procedures on the spine and hips, overeating (a tendency to gain weight).

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A neutral day for a haircut. A good time for home skin and hair care treatments.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: A time for wise decisions. It is favorable to pass on experience to students, engage in scientific work and analyze past mistakes.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams carry hints from the past. Solutions to problems you have long struggled with often come in dreams.

lunar_days.title: 23rd lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: Energy depletion, vampirism, restructuring of the body.
health_and_body.recommended: A thorough cleaning of the home, clearing the space with salt and fire, solitude.
health_and_body.caution: Crowds, conflicts, aggression, overeating, eating meat. This is an injury-prone day.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: Cutting the hair is categorically not recommended, as it may lead to worse health and conflicts.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: A hard day. Postpone important negotiations and project launches. Finish routine tasks and get rid of clutter.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: You may have heavy, troubling dreams. Do not give them a literal meaning, as they are merely a release of tension.

lunar_days.title: 24th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: The awakening of powerful forces of nature, creative energy, healing.
health_and_body.recommended: Strength training, strengthening your health, yoga, laying foundations, family practices.
health_and_body.caution: Passivity and despondency (they block creative energy), chilling.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A favorable day for a haircut: hair will become thick and strong. An excellent time for wellness treatments.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: A wonderful day for large-scale undertakings, construction, financial investments and signing long-term contracts.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams may show your potential and hidden reserves of energy. Good signs in a dream symbolize victory.

lunar_days.title: 25th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: A drop in overall tone, a need for silence and slowing down.
health_and_body.resonance: The ears, the nervous system, the fluid balance.
health_and_body.recommended: Full rest, meditation, a fasting day, solitude in nature.
health_and_body.caution: Bustle, haste, loud music, overloading the organs of hearing, alcohol.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: Refrain from going to the hair salon, as a haircut may attract melancholy and headaches.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: The day is not suited to active action. Do only what requires no haste and no risky decisions.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Intuition sharpens. Dreams may be prophetic, but because of fatigue they are easy to interpret wrongly.

lunar_days.title: 26th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: Emotional swings, a tendency toward conflict and vanity.
health_and_body.resonance: The shoulders, the teeth, the bones.
health_and_body.recommended: Cleansing treatments, the bathhouse, a light diet, keeping your emotions in check.
health_and_body.caution: Idle talk, gossip, shopping (the risk of spending money on things you do not need). The teeth are vulnerable.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A haircut today is extremely unfavorable, as it may provoke conflicts with loved ones and depression.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: A high risk of quarrels with partners and colleagues. Avoid having it out with people and closing financial deals.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams show your illusions and where you are wasting energy.

lunar_days.title: 27th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: Receiving flashes of insight, intuitive revelation, harmonization of the water in the body.
health_and_body.recommended: Water treatments, swimming, walks by bodies of water, spiritual practices and prayer.
health_and_body.caution: Alcohol and chemical drugs, as the body is incredibly sensitive to toxins.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A haircut will bring joy, improve intuition and give the hair a beautiful shine.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: A wonderful day for creative tasks, finding unconventional ways out of crises and charity.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams tonight are clear and prophetic. They often carry deep spiritual revelations and guidance from above.

lunar_days.title: 28th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: The completion of the lunar month, work on the subtle planes, vulnerable eyesight.
health_and_body.resonance: The eyes, the skin, the endocrine system.
health_and_body.recommended: Caring for your eyesight, relaxation, keeping watch over your thoughts, completing tasks.
health_and_body.caution: Straining the eyes, bright light, picking flowers and plants, pessimism.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A haircut is not recommended, but you can use light masks for the face and scalp.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: Sum things up, pay off debts, close old matters. Starting new projects is categorically off limits.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams reflect karmic lessons and show how rightly you have lived the departing lunar month.

lunar_days.title: 29th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: The hardest day of the month. Energy is at zero, with a risk of depression and injury.
health_and_body.resonance: The large intestine, the entire musculoskeletal system.
health_and_body.recommended: Complete cleansing on every level, lighting candles, getting rid of clutter and toxic people.
health_and_body.caution: Darkness, unfamiliar roads, sharp objects, alcohol, negative thoughts.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: Cutting the hair and nails is categorically forbidden, as it takes away your last strength and health.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: A critical day. No deals, trips or negotiations. Only protection, safety and inner solitude.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: You often have heavy nightmares. Do not believe them: they are the underside of the closing cycle and will evaporate by morning.

lunar_days.title: 30th lunar day

health_and_body.biorhythmic_status: Love, taking stock, harmony, the joy of being.
health_and_body.recommended: Gratitude for the month gone by, helping others, light food, unity with your family.
health_and_body.caution: Displays of selfishness, sadness, unfinished plans.

lunar_days.beauty_and_hair: A favorable day for lightly refreshing your hairstyle and for relaxing spa treatments.
lunar_days.business_and_tasks: A day of mercy and love. Complete all your tasks, rejoice in the results and prepare for the New Moon.
lunar_days.dreams_and_intuition: Dreams are bright, joyful and short. They show the blessing of the higher powers on the next cycle.
